description: Search UK Government Contracts Finder for procurement notices, tenders and contract awards.

approachMarketFrom.description: Only planning notices with an approach-to-market date on or after this date.
approachMarketFrom.title: Approach to market from

approachMarketTo.description: Only planning notices with an approach-to-market date on or before this date.
approachMarketTo.title: Approach to market to

awardedFrom.description: Only award notices awarded on or after this date.
awardedFrom.title: Awarded from

awardedTo.description: Only award notices awarded on or before this date.
awardedTo.title: Awarded to

awardedToSme.description: Only award notices where the winning supplier is marked as an SME.
awardedToSme.title: Awarded to an SME only

awardedToVcse.description: Only award notices where the winning supplier is marked as a VCSE.
awardedToVcse.title: Awarded to a VCSE only

buyerContains.description: Keep notices whose buying organisation name contains this text (case-insensitive). Applied after the server search and re-checked on every record.
buyerContains.title: Buyer name contains

cpvCodes.description: Exact CPV codes or numeric prefixes, e.g. 72000000, 72, 45215. A prefix matches every code below it.
cpvCodes.title: CPV codes or prefixes

cpvSector.description: Filter by one of the 45 CPV root sectors. A sector also matches all of its sub-codes. Leave on Any for all sectors.
enumTitles: 03000000: Agricultural, farming, fishing, forestry and related products

35000000: Security, fire-fighting, police and defence equipment
37000000: Musical instruments, sport goods, games, toys, handicraft and art materials

39000000: Furniture, furnishings, domestic appliances and cleaning products

55000000: Hotel, restaurant and retail trade services
63000000: Supporting and auxiliary transport services; travel agencies services
71000000: Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services

cpvSector.title: CPV sector

deadlineFrom.description: Only notices whose tender deadline is on or after this date.
deadlineFrom.title: Closing from

deadlineTo.description: Only notices whose tender deadline is on or before this date.
deadlineTo.title: Closing to

dedupeByOcid.description: When enabled, keep only the latest release for each OCDS procurement (ocid). Search rows without an ocid fall back to the notice ID.
dedupeByOcid.title: One record per procurement

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full notice batch (buyer contact, awards, documents, withdrawal data). One batch request per 50 notices.
includeDetails.title: Include full notice details

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. The Search API returns at most 1,000 matches per request; recent follows cursor pages.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to scrape. recent follows the OCDS feed; search uses the Contracts Finder Search API; byStatus is the legacy alias for search + status; byNoticeId fetches specific notices.
enumTitles: Search notices by keyword and filters
Fetch specific notices by ID or URL
mode.sectionDescription: Pick the lookup path, then set only the filters you need.
mode.title: Mode

noticeIds.description: For mode=byNoticeId: Contracts Finder notice GUIDs or notice URLs, one per line. Release IDs are accepted too.
noticeIds.sectionDescription: Fetch exact notices by ID or pasted URL.
noticeIds.title: Notice IDs or URLs

onlyOpen.description: Keep only Open notices whose closing date is in the future.
onlyOpen.title: Still open for bids

publishedFrom.description: Only notices first published on or after this date.
publishedFrom.sectionDescription: Published, closing, award and approach-to-market ranges.
publishedFrom.title: Published from

publishedTo.description: Only notices first published on or before this date.
publishedTo.title: Published to

regions.description: Only notices delivered in these regions. Leave empty for every region. Any-region notices are always included.
regions.title: Delivery regions

searchQuery.description: Words or phrases to find in the notice title, description, buyer, supplier or CPV text (mode=search or byStatus). Supports "exact phrase", +required words and OR by default, like Contracts Finder.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Server-side keyword, status and stage filters.
searchQuery.title: Keyword search

sortOrder.description: Order of the delivered records. Legacy sort values are still accepted.
sortOrder.title: Sort order

stage.description: Filter by the stage of the notice. Open tenders are Contract notices with status Open; awards are Contract notices with status Awarded; pipeline and early engagement are separate notice types. Recent's all-stage feed also includes implementation releases; the Search API has no reliable implementation-only filter.
stage.title: Procurement stage

status.description: Filter by notice status. Legacy values active/closed/cancelled/complete are still accepted and mapped to Open/Closed/Withdrawn/Awarded.
status.title: Notice status

subcontractOnly.description: Only notices marked as subcontract or supply-chain opportunities.
subcontractOnly.title: Subcontract notices only

suitableForSme.description: Only notices marked suitable for small and medium enterprises.
suitableForSme.title: Suitable for SMEs only

suitableForVcse.description: Only notices marked suitable for voluntary, community and social enterprises.
suitableForVcse.title: Suitable for VCSEs only

valueFrom.description: Only notices whose stated value range reaches at least this amount. Notices with no stated value are dropped when a value or date filter is set.
valueFrom.title: Minimum value (GBP)

valueTo.description: Only notices whose stated value range starts at or below this amount.
valueTo.title: Maximum value (GBP)

title: UK Contracts Finder Scraper Input
